svg.text: The crew phone is the desk at 390 px: what's next first, then what needs the crew (U13).
Calling a match sets where and an optional lobby id, and emits tournament.match.called (D1).
The stage QR is Notify's rotating code with purpose tournament:<session> (built, #35) (D6).
Marking present is the only way in for a guest without an account (the lead's note) (U12).
A quick result needs the winner only; who played comes from the voice roster (U8).
The champion photo is taken on the crew phone and stored in the tenant's files (D9).
